entities.name: 5GMM STATUS message
entities.description: A 5GMM protocol status message received by the AMF from the UE.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that receives the 5GMM STATUS message.

entities.name: No radio interface action
entities.description: Condition specifying that no state transition or specific action shall be taken as seen from the radio interface upon receipt of 5GMM STATUS message.

entities.name: Local actions implementation dependent
entities.description: Property indicating that local actions taken by AMF upon receipt of 5GMM STATUS message are implementation dependent.

relations.description: Receipt of 5GMM STATUS message establishes that no radio interface action is required.
Receipt of 5GMM STATUS message establishes that local AMF actions are implementation dependent.
AMF receives and processes the 5GMM STATUS message.
